verdict: Organic profiles holding; paid is paused and setup milestones need to close.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — paid advertising (Meta and Google Ads) has been inactive for the full 28-day window, meaning no paid leads were generated this period. Google Business Profile is the sole source of inbound activity, delivering a combined 349 actions across the group, though all three profiles saw sharp week-over-week drops in the final days of the period, with Advance Grinding down 89% and Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision each down 75% in the most recent 7-day comparison. A set of CRM and outreach setup milestones — some dating back to July — remain open, and closing them is the prerequisite for launching contact outreach sequences and activating pipeline automations. Those blockers are being worked through now, with outreach sequences and automation targeting a September–October go-live.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply in the final days of this period across all three locations, with zero actions recorded on several consecutive days — a confirmed dip, not a single-day blip.
watch_item.fix: A web and SEO root-cause review is in motion; reindexing and profile strengthening work is targeting a recovery by end of October.
